records.translation: 当 ``ops_prefix_minority_min_reads`` 为 2 或更大时（条目 967，alpha）：细胞判定和调参排除少数条形码的零散读数（:func:`prefix_cell_calls`），细胞表增加 ``minority_ignored`` 和 ``minority_rescued``，``site_summary.csv`` 增加 ``cells_minority_rescued``（仅因该规则而被判定的已分配基因型细胞），并且每个微孔板样本位置有一行报告被挽回的细胞。0 为默认值，写出的内容与运行以前写出的相同；

records.context: with ``ops_prefix_tuning_min_sites`` above 0 (item 982 small-well guard, alpha): a tuned well with fewer sites keeps the read-quality floor at :data:`SMALL_WELL_FLOOR` and tunes only the other settings; the log says so, and the well's tuning json and ``tuning`` entry gain ``small_well_floor`` and ``small_well_sites``. 0, the default, writes what the processing session wrote before.
records.label: spacr.ops_prefix.run_prefix_decode#12
records.source: with ``ops_prefix_tuning_min_sites`` above 0 (item 982 small-well guard, alpha): a tuned well with fewer sites keeps the read-quality floor at :data:`SMALL_WELL_FLOOR` and tunes only the other settings; the log says so, and the well's tuning json and ``tuning`` entry gain ``small_well_floor`` and ``small_well_sites``. 0, the default, writes what the run wrote before.
records.translation: 当 ``ops_prefix_tuning_min_sites`` 大于 0 时（条目 982 的小样本位置保护，alpha）：位点更少的已调参微孔板样本位置将读取质量下限保持为 :data:`SMALL_WELL_FLOOR`，只调节其他设置；日志会说明，样本位置的调参 json 和 ``tuning`` 条目增加 ``small_well_floor`` 和 ``small_well_sites``。0 为默认值，写出的内容与运行以前写出的相同。
